en.t: ...suddenly woke with a start from a dream.

units.source_text: 老师应做的事，我作为侍僧都协助做了。

en.t: As an acolyte, I helped with everything the teacher was supposed to do.

units.source_text: 对侍僧来说，列席这种仪式本来是很自豪的，

en.t: For an acolyte, being present at such a ceremony was normally a great honor,

units.source_text: 但是当天的主宾却是鹿苑寺住持。

en.t: but the guest of honor that day was the abbot of Rokuonji.

units.source_text: 主宾嗣香完毕，一定要敲打一下白糙，

en.t: After the guest of honor completed the succession incense rite, he had to strike the white mortar once,

units.source_text: 证明新任住持并非赝浮图，也就是说并非冒牌和尚。

en.t: to prove that the newly appointed abbot was not a false Buddha, that is to say, not a fake monk.
